To submit this deliverable, follow these instructions:

1. Render your `.qmd` file(s) by either clicking the "Preview" button in Positron or running `quarto render` in the terminal.
2. Open the rendered html file and make sure it looks good! Is all the formatting as you expected?
3. Commit and push your work to your team's repo (`madd-f26/madd-team-<letter>`, where `<letter>` is your team letter) using GitHub Desktop: look at the diff, write a short commit message, click **Commit**, then **Push**.

::: {.callout-note title="Remember"}
This deliverable isn't submitted until it's **pushed** to your team repo. Any team member can push -- there's no need to designate just one person. Go look at your repo on GitHub.com and confirm the work is actually there before you call this done.
:::
